guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: 查看 Onchain.cc
guide.description: 原文要求进入 Onchain.cc 终端，在首页点击开始交易（Start trading）。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Head to the Onchain.cc terminal and click “Start trading” on the landing page.

guide.title: 了解 Privy 登录方式
guide.description: 原文列出邮箱（创建嵌入式非托管钱包）、Google 账号（使用 Gmail 登录的同类流程）、外部 EVM 钱包（如 MetaMask 或 Rabby）三种方式，并声称 Privy 管理密钥但不托管资金。具体密钥控制、恢复和签名方式需核对产品说明。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Sign in using one of the supported methods: Email — Privy creates an embedded non-custodial wallet for you. Google account — same flow as email, signed in with Gmail. External EVM wallet — connect MetaMask, Rabby, or another EVM wallet. Privy handles key management without holding your funds, so you keep custody throughout.

guide.title: 核对钱包资金要求
guide.description: 原文称右上角钱包菜单可查看 Solana 与 EVM 地址，交易需持有 USDC、SOL 或 ETH。交易所推广与跨链组件广告已省略，不据此要求充值。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Open the wallet menu in the top right to see your Solana and EVM addresses. Ensure you have USDC, SOL, or ETH in your wallet. If you don’t have any, you can get them from Binance or swap and bridge funds directly using the widget below.

guide.title: 了解首次交易流程
guide.description: 原文提供三种市场入口：Degen Feed（Trenches，仅 Solana 的热门及新发迷因币）、合约地址搜索（输入代币合约地址 CA）、发现（Discover，按交易量、市值等筛选）。随后设置数量、核对滑点并提交；积分取决于交易量和当时活动倍数。跨链组件广告已省略。交易可能亏损，空投未确认。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab Three discovery paths feed into the same trading panel: Degen Feed (Trenches): Solana-only memecoin discovery with trending tokens and new launches. Contract address search: paste any token’s CA into the search bar to load its chart directly. Discover tab: filter by volume, market cap, or other criteria to find trending markets. Set your size, check the slippage estimate, and submit. Points accrue automatically based on your volume and any session multipliers active at the time.

guide.title: 查看 Colosseum 排行榜
guide.description: 原文称 Colosseum 页签可查看赛季、会话计时器和奖励时段（Bonus Windows）；奖励时段通常为数小时内 2 倍或 3 倍积分。倍数和时段以当前活动页面为准。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Open the Colosseum tab to see the active season, current session timer, and any live Bonus Windows. Trading during a Bonus Window (typically 2x or 3x points for a few hours) is the fastest way to push your session rank.

guide.title: 了解 X 发帖积分
guide.description: 原文称在 X 发布与平台相关的内容并标记 @Onchaincc，可由 AI 按质量、触达和互动给出 0–100 分，获得 Colosseum 积分；真实交易内容、终端截图和自然互动得分较高，垃圾和复制内容接近零分。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Onchain.cc runs a social scoring system that pays Colosseum points for posting about the platform on X. Tag the official @Onchaincc account so the AI scorer picks up your post. Quality, reach, and engagement determine the score on a 0–100 scale. Posts that share a real trade, include a screenshot of the terminal, or generate organic engagement score well. Spam and copy-paste content score near zero.

guide.title: 了解 Hyperliquid 永续合约市场
guide.description: 原文称永续合约（perps）页签提供 Hyperliquid 的 300 多个市场，交易量计入 Colosseum 积分。杠杆及资金费率会带来额外风险，未经核验不应按积分说明开仓。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Switch to the perps tab to trade Hyperliquid’s 300+ markets from the same interface. Perp volume feeds into your Colosseum points the same way spot volume does, often with higher leverage and tighter spreads. Check funding rates before opening leveraged positions.

guide.title: 了解每周会话与邀请任务
guide.description: 原文称会话每周重置，各有排行榜和 USDC 奖池；每日、每周任务增加积分及奖池资格，邀请朋友也可获得积分。具体资格需核对活动规则。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Sessions reset weekly, each with its own leaderboard and USDC prize pool. Daily and weekly quests sit alongside the leaderboard, adding points and prize pool entries on top of your trading activity. You can also refer your friends to earn more points.

存在一定风险，新手请务必先阅读风险提示再决定。
